about.label: ABOUT
about.title: Turning requirements into features that actually ship
about.p1: I'm a Junior Developer at Learn Tech since August 2024, responsible for the company's main LMS platform across the full stack — from audit logging and PDPA-compliant user data management to social learning features, admin reporting and SCORM/xAPI content.
about.p2: In parallel I'm finishing a B.Eng. in Computer and Electronics Engineering at Ramkhamhaeng University. My final-year project is GoSkillUp LMS, built with Next.js, Prisma and Docker.

learntech.title: Junior Developer
